verdict.rationale: Stripe docs confirm stablecoin payouts to Connect platform recipients (USDC balance appears after wallet link, docs-8/9/23) and mention conversion/payout handling by Stripe, but the API-level detail on paying an arbitrary wallet address, tracking payout status codes, and confirming final settlement is thin — most detail is at the 'connected account' level rather than a generic wallet-address payout API. Community evidence (comm-8) also notes real-world restrictions (only individuals/sole proprietors can be paid in crypto, companies not supported), and comm-9 flags friction/delays in de-tokenizing back to fiat, undercutting the smooth 'status tracking to final settlement' picture. missing for 10: explicit API docs for sending to a raw wallet address (not just connected accounts), documented payout status/webhook lifecycle to settlement, and confirmation that non-individual recipients are supported.
